positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
• Maintained U-Haul’s high-volume SaaS WebSelfStorage application, including implementing new features and general bug fixes
• Assisted in the design, implementation and maintenance of a .NET Core CMS for U-Haul's self-storage affiliates
• Designed an Azure cloud hosted, .NET Core API driven SPA with a Vue.Js front-end, used for managing and deploying affiliate website instances
• Managed resource groups and their resources using Azure Cloud
• Designed and implemented a .NET Core RESTFUL API to integrate self-storage facility gate units with
WebSelfStorage’s management software

positions.title: Network Operations Specialist
positions.description:
• Monitored OmniTRACS production systems using Splunk, Grafana and OpsGenie, to ensure system health and integrity
• Managed DNS config using Infoblox
• Developed internal .NET applications to assist in daily monitoring
• Ensured stability of customer connections over VPN/Frame Relay while monitoring message
flow through internal proprietary systems
• Manage VMS cluster disk backups
• Created and managed cases using Salesforce

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed web server and database using NodeJS, Express, MongoDB (Mlab) and Mongoose
• Created a RESTful API to connect both company and advertiser servers with mobile users
• Created Android application and implemented its integration with the Ethereum
blockchain and advertiser databases
